requirement.original: pretool-quality-gate.py blocks legitimate edits to pre-existing legacy files; design Option α (no-net-worsening exemption) and unblock 8 stuck edits in happy-dev.
requirement.clarified: Modify /root/.claude/hooks/pretool-quality-gate.py so that an Edit/Write on a file with pre-existing threshold violations is ALLOWED iff the resulting content does not strictly worsen any of the three metrics (file_lines, per-function length, max nesting). New files and brand-new violations remain blocked at the original hard thresholds.
requirement.what: Add pre-state vs post-state metric comparison to pretool-quality-gate.py.
requirement.why: Unblock 8 stuck edits across 6 legacy files in happy-dev (D7.1 instrumentation + 5.2/5.18/5.19 fixes) without weakening the quality bar for new code. Sentinel/env-var/allowlist alternatives evaluated and rejected — Option α is the most surgical, has no abuse surface (you cannot make a metric worse), and requires no per-edit human action.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Hook rejects 1-line logger.info insertions and other minimal edits to legacy files because the resulting file/function still exceeds 800/30 thresholds.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: pretool-quality-gate.py main() at lines 209-247 measures the POST-edit content against absolute thresholds; it never reads the PRE-edit content, never computes deltas, and has no grandfather/no-net-worsening logic.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — hook has been threshold-only since inception per dev-registry observations.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Original design optimized for 'enforce quality bar on new code'; legacy code was assumed to be either compliant or deferred to dedicated refactor cycles.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Real-world legacy files (AgentInput.tsx 1393 lines, sync.ts 2418 lines) require continuous incremental edits (instrumentation, micro-fixes) that the hook makes impossible without expensive forced-refactor cycles.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Surfaced as a blocker on 2026-04-25 in DEV_SESSION_ID dev-20260425-201355, when 8 distinct edits were rejected; codex /close report 220425 named it Mystery 6 and recommended /redev cycle.
